# SDK Readiness Report

## Current State

| Aspect | Status |
|--------|--------|
| Official SDKs | ❌ None |
| REST API | ✅ Fully functional |
| OpenAPI Spec | ✅ Generated by Swagger |
| Auth Pattern | ✅ Stateless JWT (Bearer token) |
| SDK Generation | ✅ Auto-generatable via OpenAPI Generator |

## Auto-Generated SDK Viability

The OpenAPI specification enables code generation for **40+ languages** via [OpenAPI Generator](https://openapi-generator.tech/). The following table assesses viability for key targets:

| Language | Generator | Viability | Complexity | Priority |
|----------|-----------|-----------|------------|----------|
| **TypeScript (axios)** | `typescript-axios` | ✅ Full | Low | **P0 — Build first** |
| **Python** | `python` | ✅ Full | Low | P1 |
| **Java** | `java` | ✅ Full | Medium | P1 |
| **Go** | `go` | ✅ Full | Medium | P2 |
| **PHP** | `php` | ✅ Full | Low | P2 |
| **Ruby** | `ruby` | ✅ Full | Low | P3 |
| **.NET/C#** | `csharp` | ✅ Full | Medium | P3 |
| **cURL** | (manual) | ✅ Full | None | Always available |

## Authentication Patterns

- **Type**: Stateless JWT (Bearer token in `Authorization` header)
- **Token acquisition**: `POST /api/v1/auth/login` → `{ accessToken, refreshToken }`
- **Token refresh**: `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` → `{ accessToken }`
- **SDK impact**: Minimal — standard Bearer auth, no OAuth flows, no session management
- **All SDKs** can implement auth as a simple header setter on the HTTP client

## Complexity Areas

### SSE Streaming
- **Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/ai-gateway/stream`
- **Challenge**: EventSource doesn't support POST; requires fetch + ReadableStream
- **SDK Recommendation**: Provide a dedicated streaming client class using fetch + AbortController
- **TypeScript**: Use native `ReadableStream` with async iterator

### File Upload
- **Endpoints**: `POST /api/v1/media/upload`, `POST /api/v1/storage/upload`
- **Format**: `multipart/form-data`
- **SDK Handling**: Auto-generate with correct `Content-Type: multipart/form-data` boundary
- **Challenge**: SDK generators may not handle file upload well; may need manual wrapper

### WebSocket (Socket.IO)
- **Endpoint**: `/socket.io/`
- **Scope**: Real-time notifications, TradeTalk chat
- **Challenge**: Socket.IO is not REST; cannot be auto-generated
- **SDK Recommendation**: Provide a separate WebSocket client class with event types and TypeScript definitions

### Pagination
- **Pattern**: `{ data: T[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages, hasNext, hasPrevious } }`
- **SDK Handling**: Auto-generate from response DTOs
- **All SDKs**: Works automatically with typed responses

## Recommended SDK Build Order

```
Phase 1 (P0): TypeScript SDK
  - Complete API coverage
  - SSE streaming client
  - WebSocket client
  - File upload helpers
  - TypeScript types exported
  - Published as npm package @tradhexa/api-sdk

Phase 2 (P1): Python SDK
  - Core API coverage (auth, products, RFQ, quotes, orders)
  - AI Gateway streaming via SSE client
  - Published as PyPI package tradhexa-api

Phase 3 (P1): Java SDK
  - Core API coverage
  - Maven/Gradle artifact
  - Spring Boot friendly

Phase 4 (P2): Go SDK
  - Core API coverage
  - Go module
  - Context-aware cancellation
```

## Build & Release Pipeline

```yaml
# Recommended GitHub Actions workflow
steps:
  - uses: openapi-generator/openapi-generator-action@v1
    with:
      generator: typescript-axios
      input: https://api.tradhexa.com/docs-json
      output: sdks/typescript
  - run: npm run build
  - run: npm publish
```

## Recommendation

> **Build the TypeScript SDK first.** It is the most requested (powers the frontend), easiest to generate, and provides the template for all future SDKs. Follow with Python for AI/data science integration, then Java for enterprise customers.

### Quick Start for SDK Generation
```bash
# TypeScript
npx @openapitools/openapi-generator-cli generate \
  -i http://localhost:3001/docs-json \
  -g typescript-axios \
  -o ./sdks/typescript

# Python
npx @openapitools/openapi-generator-cli generate \
  -i http://localhost:3001/docs-json \
  -g python \
  -o ./sdks/python
```
